#Enjoy a beautiful boat ride through the 10,000 Islands where you'll see abundant wildlife including wild dolphins!

##About
Hop aboard the boat and enjoy a nice boat ride through the mangrove nearshore estuary of the Ten Thousand Islands National Wildlife Refuge. Dolphins, manatees, and birds are common sightings, we also sometimes see stingrays, fish, sea turtles, sharks,  etc. Wildlife sightings depend on the time of year, although we see dolphins year-round.
